#bot.Expression.NoBlush
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
Policeman: If it was me, I wouldn’t go outside with a girl like this. Never! 
Policeman: Pretty girls…{{wi}} You lose sight of one for one minute and she already goes to some guy named Josh to hang out. A week later she tells you that it’s not going to work. That it’s not your fault, but hers, and that she wishes you both could stay friends.
You: …
Bot: That was…{{wi}} weirdly specific.
Policeman: N-no it wasn’t! That happens more often than you think! 
You: Yeah. {{wi}}Was Josh a sports guy?
Policeman: Nah, he was more dude with a rich daddy type of guy.
Policeman: …
Policeman: A-anyway, I’m actually kind of busy and you people wasted enough of my time.
You: You didn’t sound busy before. Come on, tell us more about that Josh guy.
Bot: Right!
#Policeman.Face.annoyed
Policeman: Y-you both got some balls! H-harassing a police o-officer on active duty like t-that!
Policeman: Maybe I should arrest you after all, huh!?
You: For what?!
Policeman: Do I really need a reason? I-I will just make something up! 
Policeman: Yes! Yes! No one would believe you two, haha! I can do whatever I want!
Policeman: I’M THE LAW!
